rules: Retain production-oriented studies on eligible salmonids where the work directly concerns feeding, growth, rearing, reproduction, smolt transfer, transport/handling, stunning/processing, disease transmission or other husbandry operations, even when the word commercial is absent.

Retain environmental or ecological studies where aquaculture itself is a substantive exposure, operation, source or impact being investigated. Exclude where an aquaculture facility is merely incidental background or where the eligible-species gate is not met.
Potential future commercial application alone is not sufficient when the actual study concerns wild, hatchery-release or otherwise non-aquaculture fish.
